name: Cork Lightweight Yoga Mat “The Robin”
description:
description
specifications
use & care



Why You'll Love It. Our top-selling mat, The Robin, pairs sustainable cork with an ultra-light natural base for reliable comfort at the studio, on your next adventure, and everywhere in between.
Key Features

Lightweight & travel-ready: Easy to bring wherever your practice takes you.
Superior grip: Cork naturally increases traction with moisture, making it ideal for sweaty or hot yoga classes.
Naturally antimicrobial: Say goodbye to harsh cleaning chemicals – resists mold, mildew, and odors.
Eco-conscious design: Made with sustainable cork and recyclable materials.
Attractive aesthetic: Natural cork surface that looks great at home or in the studio.




Dimensions: 72″ × 26″
Thickness: 5 mm
Weight: 1.9 lbs
Rolled Diameter: 4"
Top Material: 100% sustainable cork
Base Material: Eco-friendly, slip resistant foam (100% recyclable, free of PVC, plasticizers, and latex.)




Before first use: Unroll and let it lay flat for a few hours.
During practice: Place cork side up — you can lightly mist with water for even more grip.
Cleaning: Wipe with a damp cloth after practice. For deeper cleaning, try our natural yoga mat spray; avoid harsh cleaners to protect the cork surface.
Drying: Always air-dry completely before rolling up to prevent moisture buildup.
Storage: Store in a cool, dry place, rolled cork-side out to preserve shape.
